title: Time-lapse of X-59 Quiet SuperSonic Technology aircraft (May 2019 - June 2021)
description: This time-lapse represents manufacturing of the X-59 Quiet SuperSonic Technology, or QueSST, aircraft from May 2019 to June 2021 and includes the merger of its main sections - the wing, tail assembly, and fuselage or forward section. The first flight of the X-59 QueSST is planned for 2022.
